:::{#exr-square-matrix-practice}
#### Whether a data matrix times its transpose is square

Many statistical methods start from an $n \times p$ data [matrix](#def-matrix) $\matr{X}$,
with one [row](#def-matrix-row) per observation,
and form the [product](#def-matrix-mult) $\tp{\matr{X}}\matr{X}$ of its [transpose](#def-matrix-transpose) with itself.
Whether that product is [square](#def-square-matrix) matters,
because several later results apply only to [square matrices](#def-square-matrix).

Is $\tp{\matr{X}}\matr{X}$ square?

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

Find the shape of $\tp{\matr{X}}$ from @def-matrix-transpose,
then the shape of the [product](#def-matrix-mult) from @def-matrix-mult.
